name: KOReader
subtitle: An e-book reader for many formats
description: KOReader is a free e-book and document reader with its own full interface. It opens EPUB, PDF, CBZ and many other formats, and it runs on many e-readers. Primitive Store lists it as a reference: install it from KOReader's own site, and Primitive Launcher shows it on the grid once it is installed.

changes.notes: Not installed by the store. Its own install steps are on koreader.rocks.

versions.notes: Listed for reference; the store does not download or install it.
